levels.title: Ordinary Level
levels.text: A broad foundation under Rwanda's competence-based curriculum: mathematics, sciences, languages (Kinyarwanda, English, French), history, geography, ICT, religion and music.

levels.title: Advanced Level
levels.text: Specialised science combinations, building on the seminary's long tradition in Mathematics, Chemistry and Biology, examined by the National Examination and School Inspection Authority.

combinations.name: Mathematics · Physics · Computer Science
combinations.note: Physics, mathematics and ICT taught at A-Level

coCurricular.title: Brass band
coCurricular.text: The seminary fanfare leads processions, feasts and national days in full blue uniform.

coCurricular.title: Sport
coCurricular.text: Football, volleyball, basketball, handball and karate, on courts at the heart of campus.

coCurricular.title: Choir & liturgy
coCurricular.text: Sung Mass in the chapel; the seminary hymn and the music of the Church.

coCurricular.title: Science & clubs
coCurricular.text: Science fairs, debating, Xaveri youth movement and student-led clubs.

coCurricular.title: Service
coCurricular.text: Environmental work, outreach and service to the people of Muhanga.
